name: 1:1 Guidance
title: A senior product partner in your corner — for whatever you're stuck on.
lede: Bring the real thing you're wrestling with — a product decision, a stakeholder mess, a growth problem, a career fork — and we work through it live. Best as a recurring touchpoint, not a one-off pep talk.
reassure: 100% money-back guarantee — if a session isn't useful, tell me and I'll refund it in full.
forYou: Facing a product or career decision you keep going in circles on
A newer PM who wants a steady, senior sounding board
Weighing offers, a promotion case, or your next 6–12 months
Navigating stakeholders, prioritisation, or a stalled roadmap
Looking for an ongoing mentor, not a single conversation
notForYou: You want a mock interview (book Interview Preparation instead)
You're after a written resume review, not a live session
You want someone to make the decision for you

howItWorks.d: Checkout in your local currency and you'll be handed straight to booking.
Pick a 60-minute slot that suits you; add a line on what you'd like to cover.
We go deep on your actual situation — no generic advice, just your problem.
You walk away with concrete next steps, and async follow-ups between sessions if you keep going.

deliverables: A clear, prioritised plan for the problem you brought
Honest, senior perspective from someone who's shipped and hired
Frameworks you can reuse the next time it comes up

items.quote: You were very patient and very explanatory, very easy to understand — making me remember even simple concepts I didn't. It made a total difference in my studies. Thank you very much.
items.name: Marcos Dos Santos

faq.a: Yes — most people get the most value from a recurring cadence. Book a single session to start, and we can settle into a regular rhythm if it's working.

faq.q: What can I bring to a session?
faq.a: Anything real: a product decision, a roadmap you're unsure about, stakeholder tension, a career move, interview nerves. Come with the actual situation and we'll work it live.
If you're meeting regularly, quick async follow-ups are welcome so momentum doesn't stall between calls.

faq.q: Is this different from a mock interview?
faq.a: Yes. This is open guidance on whatever you're facing. If you specifically want interview practice, book the Interview Preparation services.

finalCta.title: Get a senior sounding board in your corner.
finalCta.sub: Book a 60-minute session and leave with a plan you can act on.
